greeting: Hi! I'm the Sunrise Tech Academy assistant. Ask me about courses, fees, timings or admissions.

faqs.a: We offer 4 courses: Python for Beginners, Data Science with Python, Machine Learning, and Web Development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

faqs.q: Do you teach other languages like Java or C++?
faqs.a: Right now we teach Python, Data Science, Machine Learning and Web Development (which includes JavaScript). Java and C++ aren't offered yet, but tell us if you're interested and we'll let you know when they start.
Python for Beginners is Rs 15,000. Data Science and Web Development are Rs 25,000 each. Machine Learning is Rs 35,000. You can pay in 2 instalments.
Yes. You can pay 50% at admission and 50% after the first month.
Students get 10% off with a valid student card, and there's 15% off if two siblings or friends join together.
Weekday classes run 6 pm to 8 pm, Monday to Thursday. Weekend classes run 10 am to 2 pm on Saturdays.
Python for Beginners is 6 weeks. Data Science and Web Development are 10 weeks. Machine Learning is 12 weeks.

faqs.q: Are classes online or on campus?
faqs.a: Both. You can join on campus or online live on Zoom. Recordings are shared after every class.
Our campus is at Blue Area, Islamabad (demo address). It's a 5-minute walk from the main metro bus stop.
Fill in the online form on our website, pay the first instalment, and you'll get a confirmation email with your class link and timetable.

faqs.q: When does the next batch start?
faqs.a: New batches start on the 1st of every month. Admissions close 3 days before.
No experience is needed for Python for Beginners or Web Development. For Data Science and Machine Learning, you should know basic Python first.

faqs.q: Do I need my own laptop?
faqs.a: Yes, please bring a laptop with at least 8 GB RAM. All the software we use is free, and we'll help you install it in the first class.
Yes. You get a certificate when you complete the course and submit the final project.

faqs.q: Do you help with jobs or internships?
faqs.a: We help with your CV, GitHub portfolio and interview practice, and we share internship openings from partner companies. We can't guarantee a job.
You can get a full refund within 7 days of the batch starting. After that, the fee isn't refundable, but you can move to a later batch once.
Our trainers are working data scientists and developers with industry and teaching experience.

faqs.q: What if I miss a class?
faqs.a: Every class is recorded. You can watch the recording and ask questions in the next class or in our student WhatsApp group.

faqs.q: Are there projects in the course?
faqs.a: Yes, every course is practical. You build a project every week and one final project for your portfolio.
Yes, we run a women-only weekend batch for every course.
WhatsApp us at 0300-0000000 or email hello@sunrise-demo.example (demo contact details).
